A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Prisoner/Legends|inmate]] designated '''THX 1137''' was incarcerated in the [[Royal prison/Legends|royal prison]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. 

==Biography==
[[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] entered the [[Royal prison/Legends|royal prison]] under the guise of wanting to perform an interrogation. As she walked by the unnamed [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner's]] cell, they gave her a fierce glare. Tano, in turn, narrowed her own [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] at them before she continued on her way.<ref name="The Academy"/>

==Physical appearance==
The [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] had a fair complexion paired with light [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and close-cropped, short blond [[Hair/Legends|hair]], indicating that they were one of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]], who were a predominantly pale-skinned, blue-eyed, and blond-haired population. Like their fellow prisoners, they were attired in an orange, brown, and white [[Clothing/Legends|prison uniform]]. The uniform worn by this unnamed person bore the prisoner number "THX 1137" written in [[Mandalorian (writing system)/Legends|Mandalorian]], although the numerals were presented in an alternative font, with the digit 1 having a completely different design, and the number 7 looking like the standard number 1.<ref name="The Academy" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner's]] designation, THX-1137, is a reference to<ref name="The Academy" /> [[George Lucas]]' first theatrical film [[Wikipedia:THX 1138|''THX 1138'']]. A variety of ''[[Star Wars]]'' titles and releases contain [[1138 (easter egg)|references]] to this film.<ref name="SW">{{SW|url=news/beyond-a-cell-block-references-to-thx-1138-in-star-wars|text=Beyond a Cell Block: References to ''THX 1138'' in ''Star Wars''|nolive=1}}</ref>
